{{Top|leg}}
'''Audio/visual/holo cables''', or '''AVS cables''', were a type of cable. Thousands of [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of AVS cables were used in the [[SoroSuub secure uplink station]] in [[G'rinn Go city]], [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they were considered arcane technology.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
